applicant_utility.summary: This is Bai Xian Asia Institute's flagship master's scholarship at Tsinghua, worth up to USD 25,000 per year (USD 50,000 across the degree) and aimed squarely at future Asian leaders. Admission runs through two gates: you must first hold a place on a full-time international master's programme filed through Tsinghua's own portal, then email a separate scholarship pack - including a recorded three-minute video - to your target department by 1 March. It cannot be combined with any other Tsinghua scholarship, and scholars commit to BXAI enrichment activities including a summer programme in Beijing.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Asian nationals with a strong service-and-leadership record who want a Tsinghua master's and are comfortable with a video-based application.
application_readiness_checklist: File the Tsinghua master's application at yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn first - scholarship materials are only considered for pre-admitted students
Email the AFLSP pack to your target department before 1 March Beijing time, naming every file THU-Name-Material
Record and host the three-minute video link that the application form requires
Get transcripts stamped by your university and a signed English recommendation letter on official letterhead
Confirm your target programme runs at the Beijing campus, not at Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School
common_rejection_risks: Applying to a Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School programme - the scholarship is explicitly closed to SIGS applicants
Incomplete packs: the page warns that applications with incomplete documents will not be processed
Holding or accepting another scholarship for study at Tsinghua, which disqualifies candidates
Missing the department email deadline even though the portal application closed earlier
Missing the English proficiency certificate, or transcripts that are unstamped or not in English
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: International airfare is not mentioned as covered; you still carry visa costs, the Tsinghua application fee, and personal spending beyond the living allowance.
document_audit: The application form itself must embed a three-minute video link - plan filming time
Recommendation letters need official letterhead and the issuing institution's identity
Everything must be in English; transcripts must carry the university stamp
File names must follow the THU-Name-Material convention exactly
alerts: The award is incompatible with other Tsinghua scholarships; any third-party funding must be disclosed to BXAI
Second-year disbursement depends on satisfactory academic performance in year one
Scholars must attend the BXAI Summer Program (up to three weeks) and mandatory enrichment programmes in Beijing
Exchange or overseas study outside Asia can pause disbursement - notify BXAI first
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Two gates: the Tsinghua portal application first, then the emailed department pack; departments nominate by late March, the university's AFLSP Faculty Committee nominates to BXAI by end-April, BXAI decides by end-May and results land in June.
